# About Topographer

Topographer is an open Python toolkit for topology-aware analysis of scalar
networks. Version 0.5.0 is the first public release. Earlier versions were
developed privately.

For academic use, please cite **Igors Dubanevics, Topographer**, version
0.5.0. A Zenodo DOI will be added to `CITATION.cff` when the public archive
exists. The machine-readable citation is in
[`CITATION.cff`](https://github.com/oist/topographer/blob/main/CITATION.cff).
Topographer is distributed under the [MIT license](https://github.com/oist/topographer/blob/main/LICENSE.md).
Contribution guidance lives in the repository’s
[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/oist/topographer/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
